source: Written 2026-10-16 from the verified oracle text (Scryfall via carddb --verify, fetched 2026-10-15) for every card a scene shows or names, the commander's text as quoted in this deck's notes, and this deck's notes. Cards a caption names are [[bracketed]] so clips.py checks them against the current list; double-faced cards carry the deck file's full name. Opponents' cards are placeholders, never named. The only power and toughness stated is the Zombie token's (Waste Not's oracle text). Commander starting life is 40 (CR 903.7). Discarding moves a card from hand to its owner's graveyard (CR 701.9a); Tinybones, Megrim, Liliana's Caress and Waste Not each trigger once per card discarded. Megrim's damage makes the player lose that much life (CR 120.3a); the Caress is life loss (CR 119.3). The stash: you control a spell you cast (CR 601.2a), so a stashed permanent enters under your control (CR 608.3a); "mana of any type" changes only how the cost is paid (CR 609.4b); a stashed land is played, not cast (CR 305.1), so it uses your land play for the turn (CR 305.2a) and makes no Gonti Treasure; the play permission is Tinybones' own ability, so it works only while he is on the battlefield (CR 113.6), and the stash counters stay on the exiled cards meanwhile (CR 122.2). Tinybones' {3}{B}, {T} needs him under your control since the turn began (CR 302.6). Unspent mana empties at the end of each step and phase (CR 106.4, 500.5), so Waste Not's {B}{B} is spent in the same main phase. Tergrid: both triggers are yours, so you choose their order (CR 603.3b) and the last one put on the stack resolves first (CR 405.5); a card that leaves the graveyard is a new object (CR 400.7), so the other trigger finds nothing; an instant or sorcery is not a permanent card, so only Tinybones triggers. Dark Deal: five discarded, four drawn. Mayhem is CR 702.187b; Sandman's Quicksand's reminder text says timing rules still apply, so the sorcery waits for a main phase with an empty stack. Class levels go up one at a time, as a sorcery (CR 716.2a). Bandit's Talent level 2 and Asylum Visitor check their 'if' as they trigger and again as they resolve (CR 603.4); the draw step's normal draw comes first (CR 504.1), so level 3 with three opponents at one card or fewer makes four cards. Attacking taps Aclazotz (CR 508.1f). Entropic Battlecruiser's 1+ ability needs one or more charge counters (CR 721.2a). A Treasure is CR 111.10a.

scenes.head: Tinybones, Bauble Burglar — mono-black discard
scenes.sub: Every card an opponent discards becomes a card you can play: make them discard, charge them for it, spend the stash.
scenes.say: Tinybones, Bauble Burglar. Mono-black discard, where every card an opponent discards becomes a card you can play. Make them discard, charge them for every card, then spend the stash.

scenes.head: Their discards become your stash
scenes.sub: Whenever an opponent discards a card, Tinybones exiles it from their graveyard with a stash counter on it.
scenes.say: Their discards become your stash. Whenever an opponent discards a card, Tinybones exiles it from their graveyard with a stash counter on it.

scenes.head: Your turn: play the stash with any mana
scenes.sub: During your turn, you may play cards you don't own with stash counters on them, and mana of any type can be spent to cast them.
scenes.say: On your turn, you spend the stash. During your turn, you may play cards you don't own with stash counters on them, and mana of any type can be spent to cast them. Their colors don't matter: your Swamps can cast them.

cards.ph: Their card, cast with your mana

scenes.head: Turn 3: [[Burglar Rat]]
scenes.sub: Tinybones came down on turn 2, for {1}{B}. The Rat costs {1}{B} too: when it enters, each opponent discards a card.
scenes.say: Turn three: Burglar Rat. Tinybones came down on turn two, for one and a black. The Rat costs the same, and when it enters, each opponent discards a card.

scenes.head: Three discards, three cards in your stash
scenes.sub: Tinybones triggers once for each card. Each one leaves its owner's graveyard for exile, with a stash counter on it.
scenes.say: Three discards, so three cards in your stash. Tinybones triggers once for each card, and each one leaves its owner's graveyard for exile, with a stash counter on it.

scenes.head: Turn 4: cast their creature with Swamps
scenes.sub: It costs {2}{G}. Mana of any type can be spent, so three Swamps pay. You cast it, so it enters under your control.
scenes.say: Turn four: cast their creature with your Swamps. It costs two and a green, but mana of any type can be spent, so three black pays for it. You cast it, so it enters the battlefield under your control.

scenes.head: Your turn only, with Tinybones out
scenes.sub: On their turns the stash waits. The permission is his own: if he dies, it waits until he's back.
scenes.say: Your turn only, and only with Tinybones out. On their turns, the stash waits. The permission is his own, so if he dies, the stash waits until he's back. A stashed land is played as your land for the turn.

scenes.head: Every turn after: {3}{B} and tap
scenes.sub: Tinybones' own ability: each opponent discards a card. Activate it only as a sorcery: three more cards for the stash, every turn.
scenes.say: And every turn after that: pay three and a black, and tap Tinybones. Each opponent discards a card. It's sorcery speed, so use it in your main phase: three more cards for the stash, every turn.

scenes.head: Punishers first, then the discard
scenes.sub: A [[Burglar Rat]] on turn 2 takes one card from each opponent. The same Rat after [[Megrim]] and [[Liliana's Caress]] is 12 life.
scenes.say: Punishers first, then the discard. A Burglar Rat on turn two takes one card from each opponent. The same Rat after Megrim and Liliana's Caress is twelve life.

scenes.head: Two punishers: 4 life per card
scenes.sub: Whenever an opponent discards a card, [[Megrim]] deals 2 damage to that player, and [[Liliana's Caress]] makes them lose 2 life.
scenes.say: Two punishers, four life for every card. Whenever an opponent discards a card, Megrim deals two damage to that player, and Liliana's Caress makes them lose two life.

scenes.head: Turn 4: [[Liliana's Caress]], then [[Burglar Rat]]
scenes.sub: Tinybones came down on turn 2 and Megrim on turn 3. The Caress and the Rat cost {1}{B} each; cast the Caress first.
scenes.say: Turn four. Tinybones came down on turn two, and Megrim on turn three. Now Liliana's Caress, then Burglar Rat, for one and a black each. The Caress goes first, so both punishers see the discards.

scenes.head: Each opponent discards: 12 life
scenes.sub: Each takes 2 damage from Megrim and loses 2 to the Caress: 4 each, 12 across three opponents. Tinybones stashes all three cards.
scenes.say: The Rat enters, and each opponent discards a card. Each one takes two damage from Megrim and loses two life to the Caress: four each, twelve across three opponents. And Tinybones stashes all three cards.

scenes.head: [[Waste Not]]: every discard pays you
scenes.sub: Whenever an opponent discards a creature card, create a 2/2 black Zombie. A land card: add {B}{B}. Anything else: draw a card.
scenes.say: Waste Not: every discard pays you. Whenever an opponent discards a creature card, you create a two-two black Zombie. A land card adds two black mana. Anything else draws you a card.

scenes.head: Turn 5: [[Waste Not]], then [[Hecteyes]]
scenes.sub: Hecteyes makes each opponent discard. A creature card: a Zombie. A land: {B}{B}. An instant: a card. And 12 more life.
scenes.say: Turn five: Waste Not, then Hecteyes, one and a black each. Each opponent discards: a creature card makes you a Zombie, a land gives you two black mana, an instant draws you a card. And that's twelve more life.

scenes.head: Spend Waste Not's {B}{B} this phase
scenes.sub: Unspent mana empties when the phase ends. {B}{B} and your fifth Swamp cast a three-mana card from the stash.
scenes.say: Spend Waste Not's mana in this phase: unspent mana empties when the phase ends. Two black from Waste Not, plus your fifth Swamp, casts a three-mana card from the stash.

scenes.head: More punishers in the 99
scenes.sub: [[Raiders' Wake]] and [[Fell Specter]]: 2 life per discard. [[Entropic Battlecruiser]]: 3, from one charge counter. [[Geth's Grimoire]]: you may draw.
scenes.say: More punishers in the ninety-nine. Raiders' Wake and Fell Specter each make them lose two life per discard. Entropic Battlecruiser makes it three, once it has a charge counter. And Geth's Grimoire lets you draw a card.

scenes.head: [[Tergrid, God of Fright // Tergrid's Lantern|Tergrid]] takes permanent cards
scenes.sub: Whenever an opponent sacrifices a nontoken permanent or discards a permanent card, you may put that card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.
scenes.say: Tergrid, God of Fright. Whenever an opponent sacrifices a nontoken permanent, or discards a permanent card, you may put that card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.

cards.name: Tergrid, God of Fright // Tergrid's Lantern

scenes.head: Turn 6: Tinybones, {3}{B} and tap
scenes.sub: Tergrid came down on turn 5. Each opponent discards a card: a creature card, an instant and a sorcery.
scenes.say: Turn six. Tergrid came down last turn, for five Swamps. Now pay three and a black, and tap Tinybones: each opponent discards a card. One discards a creature card, one an instant, and one a sorcery.

cards.name: Tergrid, God of Fright // Tergrid's Lantern

scenes.head: One permanent card, two triggers
scenes.sub: The creature card triggers Tergrid and Tinybones. Both are yours, so you stack them in any order. The last one in resolves first.
scenes.say: One permanent card, two triggers. The creature card triggers both Tergrid and Tinybones. Both triggers are yours, so you put them on the stack in any order you like, and the last one you put there resolves first.

cards.name: Tergrid, God of Fright // Tergrid's Lantern

scenes.head: Tergrid's on top: the creature is yours
scenes.sub: It comes onto the battlefield under your control. Then Tinybones' trigger resolves, finds nothing in the graveyard, and does nothing.
scenes.say: Put Tergrid's trigger on top, and the creature is yours: it comes straight onto the battlefield under your control. Then Tinybones' trigger resolves, finds nothing left in the graveyard, and does nothing.

cards.name: Tergrid, God of Fright // Tergrid's Lantern

scenes.head: Or Tinybones' on top: the card is stashed
scenes.sub: It's exiled with a stash counter, and Tergrid's trigger finds nothing. You can cast it later, during your turn, with any mana.
scenes.say: Or put Tinybones' trigger on top, and the card is stashed instead. It's exiled with a stash counter, and Tergrid's trigger finds nothing. You can cast it during your turn, with any type of mana.

cards.name: Tergrid, God of Fright // Tergrid's Lantern

scenes.head: The instant and the sorcery go to the stash
scenes.sub: Neither is a permanent card, so Tergrid doesn't trigger. Tinybones exiles both with stash counters.
scenes.say: The instant and the sorcery go to the stash. Neither one is a permanent card, so Tergrid doesn't trigger at all, and Tinybones exiles both with stash counters.

cards.name: Tergrid, God of Fright // Tergrid's Lantern

scenes.head: Two Swamps left: [[Sheoldred's Edict]]
scenes.sub: Each opponent sacrifices a nontoken creature of their choice. Tergrid triggers on each: you may put all three onto the battlefield under your control.
scenes.say: Two Swamps left: Sheoldred's Edict, an instant, for one and a black. Each opponent sacrifices a nontoken creature of their choice. Tergrid triggers on each one, and all three can come onto the battlefield under your control.

cards.name: Tergrid, God of Fright // Tergrid's Lantern

scenes.head: Want it now? Tergrid. Everything else: the stash.
scenes.sub: Choose the order per card, every time both trigger.
scenes.say: Want it now? Put Tergrid's trigger on top. Everything else goes to the stash. Choose the order card by card, every time both trigger.

cards.name: Tergrid, God of Fright // Tergrid's Lantern

scenes.head: [[Dark Deal]]: every hand at once
scenes.sub: {2}{B}: each player discards all the cards in their hand, then draws that many cards minus one.
scenes.say: Dark Deal: every hand, all at once. For two and a black, each player discards all the cards in their hand, then draws that many cards minus one.

scenes.head: Turn 7: [[Megrim]] and [[Liliana's Caress]] are out
scenes.sub: Each opponent holds five cards. Three of your seven [[Swamp|Swamps]] cast Dark Deal: each opponent discards five, then draws four.
scenes.say: Turn seven. Megrim, Liliana's Caress and Waste Not are already out, and each opponent holds five cards. Three of your seven Swamps cast Dark Deal: each opponent discards five cards, then draws four.

scenes.head: Five cards each: each opponent loses 20
scenes.sub: Each card: 2 damage from Megrim, 2 life to the Caress. Five cards at 4 each: 20 apiece, 60 from one sorcery.
scenes.say: Five cards each, so each opponent loses twenty. Every card they discard is two damage from Megrim and two life lost to Liliana's Caress. Five cards at four each is twenty apiece: sixty life from one sorcery.

scenes.head: Fifteen cards for your stash
scenes.sub: Tinybones exiles every one with a stash counter, and [[Waste Not]] pays for each: Zombies, {B}{B} per land, cards for the rest.
scenes.say: All fifteen cards go to your stash. Tinybones exiles every one with a stash counter, and Waste Not pays you for each: a Zombie for every creature card, two black mana for every land, and a card for the rest.

scenes.head: Your hand goes too
scenes.sub: You discard yours and draw one fewer. Cast Dark Deal when your hand is small, and make [[Sandman's Quicksand]] the card you discard.
scenes.say: Your hand goes too: you discard yours and draw one fewer. So cast Dark Deal when your hand is small, and make Sandman's Quicksand the card you throw away.

scenes.head: [[Sandman's Quicksand]]: mayhem {3}{B}
scenes.sub: You may cast it from your graveyard for {3}{B} if you discarded it this turn. Timing rules still apply: it's a sorcery.
scenes.say: Sandman's Quicksand has mayhem. You may cast it from your graveyard for three and a black if you discarded it this turn. Timing rules still apply: it's a sorcery, so your main phase, with the stack empty.

scenes.head: Same main phase: [[Sandman's Quicksand|Quicksand]] for {3}{B}
scenes.sub: Once [[Dark Deal]] and its triggers resolve, pay {3}{B}: creatures your opponents control get -2/-2 until end of turn. Yours don't.
scenes.say: Same main phase: Quicksand for mayhem. Once Dark Deal and its triggers resolve, your other four Swamps pay three and a black. Creatures your opponents control get minus two minus two until end of turn, and yours don't.

scenes.head: Punishers out, hands full: then Dark Deal
scenes.sub: Hold it for full hands. If the table draws a new seven, that's when it hits hardest.
scenes.say: Punishers out, hands full: then Dark Deal. Hold it for full hands. If the table draws a fresh seven, that's when it hits hardest.

scenes.head: Empty hands still pay
scenes.sub: Once an opponent is down to one card or none, the deck keeps charging them, and keeps drawing you cards.
scenes.say: Empty hands still pay. Once an opponent is down to one card or none, the deck keeps charging them, and keeps drawing you cards.

cards.name: Aclazotz, Deepest Betrayal // Temple of the Dead

scenes.head: [[Bandit's Talent]]: {1}{B}, then level up
scenes.sub: When this Class enters, each opponent discards two cards unless they discard a nonland card. Gain each next level as a sorcery.
scenes.say: Bandit's Talent, for one and a black. When this Class enters, each opponent discards two cards, unless they discard a nonland card. Then you gain each next level as a sorcery.

scenes.head: Level 2, {B}: 2 life at their upkeep
scenes.sub: At the beginning of each opponent's upkeep, if that player has one or fewer cards in hand, they lose 2 life.
scenes.say: Level two costs one black. At the beginning of each opponent's upkeep, if that player has one or fewer cards in hand, they lose two life. Here, two of the three lose two at each of their upkeeps.

scenes.head: Level 3, {3}{B}: more cards for you
scenes.sub: At the beginning of your draw step, draw an additional card for each opponent with one or fewer cards in hand. All three: draw four.
scenes.say: Level three costs three and a black. At the beginning of your draw step, draw an additional card for each opponent who has one or fewer cards in hand. With all three there, you draw four cards instead of one.

scenes.head: [[Asylum Visitor]]: a card per empty hand
scenes.sub: At the beginning of each player's upkeep, if that player has no cards in hand, you draw a card and lose 1 life.
scenes.say: Asylum Visitor: a card for every empty hand. At the beginning of each player's upkeep, if that player has no cards in hand, you draw a card and you lose one life.

scenes.head: [[Aclazotz, Deepest Betrayal // Temple of the Dead|Aclazotz]] attacks: discard, or you draw
scenes.sub: Each opponent discards a card. For each opponent who can't, you draw a card. Two empty hands: two cards. Opponent 1 discards their last card.
scenes.say: Aclazotz attacks. Each opponent discards a card, and for each opponent who can't, you draw a card. Two empty hands give you two cards, and opponent one discards their last card, straight into your stash.

cards.name: Aclazotz, Deepest Betrayal // Temple of the Dead

scenes.head: [[Gonti, Night Minister|Gonti]]: a Treasure for every stolen spell
scenes.sub: Whenever a player casts a spell they don't own, that player creates a Treasure token. Every stashed card you cast makes you one.
scenes.say: Gonti, Night Minister: whenever a player casts a spell they don't own, that player creates a Treasure token. So every stashed card you cast makes you a Treasure. A stashed land is played, not cast, so it makes none.

scenes.head: Tinybones, Bauble Burglar
scenes.sub: Bracket 3 · mono-black discard · the full plan is in the Plan tab.
scenes.say: Tinybones, Bauble Burglar. Bracket three, mono-black discard. The full plan is in the Plan tab.
